tools.name: calculator_describe
tools.description: The inputs this calculator takes (with units, ranges and defaults), the outputs it returns, and the assumptions and tables behind it.

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Run the House rendering cost calculator calculator: Wall area used; Low end of typical 2026 quotes; High end of typical 2026 quotes. Missing inputs fall back to their documented defaults.

tools.name: enquiry_describe
tools.description: Read first. States plainly what submit_enquiry does on Render Cost Calculator: it starts an enquiry with human providers who quote directly. Nothing is bought, ordered or paid; no quote is guaranteed; it is free. Also returns who receives the details, the consent wording, and how the person confirms

tools.name: enquiry_fields
tools.description: Every field of the Render Cost Calculator enquiry: key, label, type, whether required, help text and the allowed options where there are any. Pass answers to submit_enquiry keyed by field key.

tools.name: submit_enquiry
tools.description: Submits an enquiry to Render Cost Calculator — NOT a purchase, NOT a guaranteed quote. Step 1: call with the answers (keyed by field key from enquiry_fields) and consent=true; it validates and returns a summary, the consent line and a confirmation token — show the person the summary and the consent

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: submit_enquiry · Private data: submit_enquiry · Public sink: submit_enquiry · Destructive: calculate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: submit_enquiry · Private data: submit_enquiry · Public sink: submit_enquiry · Destructive: calculate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "calculate" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Run the Render cost calculator calculator: Wall area used; Low end of typical 2026 quotes; High end of typical 2026 quotes. Missing inputs fall back to their documented defaults." → after: "Run the House rendering cost calculator calculator: Wall area used; Low end of typical 2026 quotes; High end of typical 2026 quotes. Missing inputs fall back to their documented defaults."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
